newsitem.title: USA: Tietmeyer-US wants strong but not stronger dollar.
newsitem.headline: Tietmeyer-US wants strong but not stronger dollar.

text.p: Bundesbank President Hans Tietmeyer restated on Monday that U.S. financial officials are interested in a strong but not a stronger dollar.
Speaking to reporters, Tietmeyer said "We are of the opinion that we do not want overshoots (in currency markets) and that the U.S. is interested in a strong dollar but not a stronger one."
Asked about the currency markets' reaction to the Group of Seven's statement released on Sunday night, Tietmeyer said it was necessary to see what the long-term reaction would be.
Tietmeyer said Sunday night that the G7 opposed overshoots and that the U.S. wanted a strong but not a stronger dollar.
German Finance Minister Theo Waigel also told reporters that he would have to wait and see for at least a couple of days how the markets would react to the G7 statement.
